purpose: This silver table provides a cleaned registry of aircraft tail numbers and their FAA registration attributes (manufacturer, model, manufacture year, engine configuration, seating, and cruising speed where known) for the subset of aircraft that appeared in 2013 NYC-area flights, feeding joins against flight-level fact tables on tailnum.
usage: Consumers should join on tailnum, the declared grain, to enrich flight records with aircraft characteristics; manufacture_year and speed_mph are nullable and must be filtered or coalesced explicitly before aggregation, and consumers should remember that American Airlines and Envoy Air aircraft are absent because those carriers reported fleet numbers rather than tail numbers.
limitations: speed_mph is populated for only about 0.7% of rows (null_rate 0.993076) and cannot be imputed, so speed-based analysis will cover a small fraction of the fleet; manufacture_year is missing for 2.1% of rows (null_rate 0.021072); and the table excludes any aircraft never observed in the 2013 NYC flights dataset, including entire American Airlines and Envoy Air fleets.
